items.title: Apollo Global Q2 Earnings Miss Estimates, Expenses Increase Y/Y
items.summary: APO's Q2 results are affected by higher expenses as adjusted net income misses estimates. Higher AUM and revenue growth provide support.

items.title: Ford, Google, and BlackRock Say America Needs Millions More Tradespeople. A 63-Year-Old Electrician Should Know the Overtime Catch.
items.summary: Ford, BlackRock, and Google just pledged hundreds of millions to pull experienced tradespeople back into the workforce, and a 63-year-old electrician in Ohio is answering that call without realizing the bigger paychecks could trigger two separate federal penalties at once.

items.title: Italy’s Largest Bank Cuts BlackRock Bitcoin ETF Stake 94%: Rotation to Ethereum?
items.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo cut its Bitcoin ETF stake 94% and tripled its staked Ethereum holdings. Are institutions ditching Bitcoin for Ethereum?

items.title: HYPE, ADA Outperform Bitcoin, Ethereum and XRP As Strait Of Hormuz Tensions Keep Crypto Markets On The Edge
items.summary: Bitcoin may be nearing a pivot, with on-chain data indicating a redistribution of supply, not capitulation, Bitfinex said.

items.title: Future mobility hubs link air taxis, robotaxis
items.summary: Joby Aviation is partnering with Atoms, an LA-based robotics company led by former Uber CEO Travis Kalanick, to develop next-generation vertiports for urban air taxis.

items.title: BlackRock Tokenizes $311B of European Money Market Funds With JP Morgan's Kinexys
items.summary: Europe's largest cash management platform is now issuing tokens on Ethereum, in a launch restricted to professional investors.
